sampler_audit_problems: same 18 problems as the MATLAB comparison
random_stream: MATLAB twister; same algorithm seed within each problem/seed across conditions
radius_scope: temporary niches, local ranking, and archive selection share the radius
reuse: radius 1/3 lambda 0 and 1 endpoints from completed MATLAB comparison and ablation
sampling_audit: rerun 18x30 equal-niche treatments with observation-only traces; require exact final full-state equivalence to archived MATLAB treatment
calibration_envelope: same mean absolute relative niche-count error and 2000 multinomial simulations per (draw count,niche count) as the prior audit; separate analysis RNG
holm_family: three metrics within each problem and contrast; two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank
exclusions: none; all 30 seeds and all five fixed sensitivity problems are required
